prompt: Rudi did not ___ the door before he left the house this morning.
explanation: Setelah did not, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar, jadi yang benar adalah close, bukan closed.

prompt: ___ the students finish the project before the deadline last week?
explanation: Pertanyaan lampau dimulai dengan did, lalu kata kerja tetap dalam bentuk dasar, yaitu finish.

prompt: After the bell rang, the students ___ talking and went back to their seats.
explanation: Stopped talking berarti berhenti berbicara, dan cocok dengan kalimat berikutnya tentang kembali ke tempat duduk.

prompt: At the wedding party, the guests ___ together until midnight.
explanation: Danced berarti menari, dan bentuk lampaunya danced karena dance termasuk kata kerja beraturan.

prompt: Kemarin ibu saya memasak sup untuk makan malam dan menyapu lantai.
acceptedAnswers: Yesterday my mother cooked soup for dinner and swept the floor.
Yesterday my mom cooked soup for dinner and swept the floor.
explanation: Cook menjadi cooked memakai -ed, sedangkan sweep menjadi swept adalah bentuk lampau tidak beraturan.

prompt: Mereka tidak menutup jendela sebelum pergi tidur.
acceptedAnswers: They did not close the window before they went to bed.
They didn't close the window before going to bed.
explanation: Negatif lampau memakai did not atau didn't, lalu kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar.

passage: Last Sunday, Maya and her younger brother decided to clean their backyard. They started early in the morning. Maya swept the dry leaves, and her brother watered the plants. They walked to the shop to buy new flowers. Their neighbor, Pak Budi, helped them carry the heavy pots. By noon, the yard looked fresh and green. They finished their work and played a short game before lunch.
prompt: Apa yang dilakukan adik Maya?
explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan adik Maya watered the plants, jadi jawabannya menyiram tanaman.

prompt: Ceritakan pengalamanmu membersihkan rumah atau kelas pada akhir pekan lalu. Gunakan kata kerja lampau (-ed atau did).
modelAnswer: Last weekend I cleaned my room. First, I opened the window and swept the floor. Then I washed my clothes and arranged my books. I finished the work before lunch, and I felt very happy.
explanation: Esai ini melatih kata kerja lampau beraturan untuk menceritakan kegiatan yang sudah selesai.

script: Yesterday, Ana walked to the library after school. She studied there for an hour, and then she met her friend at the entrance. They talked about their favorite movies.
prompt: Ke mana Ana pergi setelah sekolah?
explanation: Dalam rekaman disebutkan Ana walked to the library after school, sehingga jawabannya perpustakaan.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang artinya: Kami menonton film di rumah tadi malam.
acceptedAnswers: We watched a movie at home last night
explanation: Watched adalah bentuk lampau beraturan dari watch, dan last night menunjukkan waktu lampau.

prompt: Last night, the children ___ their dinner very quickly because they were hungry.
explanation: Ate adalah bentuk lampau tidak beraturan dari eat, sedangkan eaten adalah bentuk ketiga yang tidak dipakai pada simple past.

prompt: She ___ a letter to her grandmother yesterday, but she forgot to send it.
explanation: Bentuk lampau dari write adalah wrote, dan keterangan yesterday menunjukkan waktu lampau.

prompt: The thief ___ away quickly when the security guard came.
explanation: Ran away berarti lari menjauh, dan bentuk lampau dari run adalah ran.

prompt: Before the exam, I ___ two glasses of water because I was very thirsty.
explanation: Drink berarti minum dan bentuk lampaunya drank, sedangkan kata kerja lain tidak cocok dengan konteks air.

prompt: Kakek saya datang ke rumah kami pagi tadi sambil membawa madu.
acceptedAnswers: My grandfather came to our house this morning and brought some honey.
This morning my grandfather came to our house and brought honey.
explanation: Came dan brought adalah bentuk lampau tidak beraturan dari come dan bring.

prompt: Kami mengambil banyak foto ketika berlibur di Bali.
acceptedAnswers: We took many photos when we were on vacation in Bali.
We took a lot of photos when we went on holiday in Bali.
explanation: Bentuk lampau dari take adalah took, jadi kalimat yang benar memakai took.

passage: Last Saturday, Andi went to the zoo with his father. They came early and saw many animals. Andi took pictures of a tall giraffe and a sleepy lion. At noon, they ate sandwiches near the lake. Andi drank cold lemon juice and made a funny face at a monkey. Before going home, his father bought him a small toy elephant. Andi ran to the car, happy with his day.
prompt: Apa yang dibelikan ayah Andi untuknya?
explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan ayah Andi bought him a small toy elephant, yaitu boneka gajah kecil.

prompt: Ceritakan kegiatanmu kemarin, misalnya barang yang kamu beli, makanan yang kamu makan, dan hal yang kamu lihat. Gunakan minimal tiga kata kerja tidak beraturan.
modelAnswer: Yesterday I went to the traditional market with my mother. We bought fresh vegetables and some fruit. For lunch, I ate fried rice and drank a glass of tea. I also saw a man selling colorful kites, and he gave me a small one.
explanation: Esai ini melatih kata kerja tidak beraturan seperti went, bought, ate, drank, dan saw dalam cerita lampau.

script: Last weekend, Lisa took the train to Bandung. She met her old friend at the station, and they ate lunch together. Then Lisa bought a new bag and came home before dark.
prompt: Apa yang Lisa beli di Bandung?
explanation: Dalam rekaman disebutkan Lisa bought a new bag, jadi jawabannya tas baru.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang artinya: Dia membuat kue cokelat untuk pesta kemarin.
acceptedAnswers: She made a chocolate cake for the party yesterday
explanation: Made adalah bentuk lampau dari make, dan yesterday menunjukkan waktu lampau.

prompt: Last month, my family ___ to a small village near the mountain.
explanation: Went adalah bentuk lampau dari go, dan keterangan last month menunjukkan waktu yang sudah lewat.

prompt: After the long journey, we ___ very tired, but we still enjoyed the trip.
explanation: Subjek we pada masa lampau memakai were, sehingga bentuk yang benar adalah were.

prompt: The old ___ downtown has many paintings and ancient coins from the past.
explanation: Museum adalah tempat untuk menyimpan dan memamerkan benda bersejarah seperti lukisan dan koin kuno.

prompt: Our trip to the top of the ___ took four hours, but the view was amazing.
explanation: Mountain berarti gunung, dan bagian puncaknya bisa dicapai dengan perjalanan yang panjang.

prompt: Perjalanan kami ke pulau itu sangat menyenangkan.
acceptedAnswers: Our trip to the island was very fun.
Our journey to that island was very enjoyable.
explanation: Perjalanan bisa diterjemahkan sebagai trip atau journey, dan menyenangkan sebagai fun atau enjoyable.

prompt: Saya masih mengingat pengalaman itu, dan saya ingin kembali ke sana.
acceptedAnswers: I still remember that experience, and I want to return there.
I still remember that experience and I want to go back there.
explanation: Still dipakai untuk kenangan yang masih diingat sekarang, dan want to diikuti kata kerja bentuk dasar.

passage: Last month, Dina and her friends visited a traditional festival in a small town. They walked through the crowded market and tasted many snacks. Dina bought a colorful scarf and took a photo with a local dancer. In the evening, they climbed a small hill to watch the fireworks. It was a tiring day, but Dina said it was a memory she would never forget. She wrote about it in her diary that night.
prompt: Apa yang dilakukan Dina pada malam hari?
explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan Dina wrote about it in her diary that night, jadi jawabannya menulis di buku harian.

prompt: Ceritakan satu pengalaman liburanmu yang paling berkesan. Sebutkan tempat, waktu, dan apa yang kamu lakukan.
modelAnswer: Last summer I visited Lombok with my family. We stayed near a quiet beach and went swimming every morning. On the second day, we climbed a small hill and watched the sunset. That trip was an unforgettable experience for me.
explanation: Esai ini melatih simple past untuk menceritakan liburan yang sudah selesai dengan urutan waktu yang jelas.

script: Last year, Rico went on a school trip to a museum in Jakarta. He saw old maps and ancient tools there. After lunch, his class walked to a nearby market to buy snacks.
prompt: Apa yang Rico lihat di museum?
explanation: Dalam rekaman Rico saw old maps and ancient tools di museum, jadi jawabannya peta kuno dan alat kuno.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang artinya: Kami berjalan ke stasiun setelah makan siang.
acceptedAnswers: We walked to the station after lunch
explanation: Walked adalah bentuk lampau beraturan dari walk, dan after lunch berarti setelah makan siang.

prompt: We were waiting ___ the bus stop when it started to rain.
explanation: Preposisi at dipakai untuk titik tertentu seperti bus stop, sedangkan in dipakai untuk ruang di dalam sesuatu.

prompt: Last Sunday, my brother ___ to the beach with his friends and came back at sunset.
explanation: Last Sunday menunjukkan waktu lampau, sehingga kata kerja go harus berbentuk went.

prompt: The farmer was ___ for the rain all morning, but the sky stayed clear.
explanation: Waiting for berarti menunggu sesuatu, dan konteks hujan yang tidak kunjung turun cocok dengan arti ini.

prompt: We ___ two kilograms of apples at the market, and we ate some of them at the park.
explanation: Bought adalah bentuk lampau dari buy yang berarti membeli, dan cocok dengan kata benda apel.

prompt: Dia bermain bola basket di halaman sekolah kemarin sore.
acceptedAnswers: Yesterday afternoon he played basketball in the school yard.
He played basketball in the school yard yesterday afternoon.
explanation: Played adalah bentuk lampau beraturan dari play, dan in the school yard berarti di halaman sekolah.

prompt: Kami makan malam di restoran pada pukul tujuh.
acceptedAnswers: We had dinner at the restaurant at seven.
We had dinner in the restaurant at seven.
explanation: Preposisi at dipakai untuk jam (at seven) dan tempat umum (at the restaurant), sedangkan in juga bisa dipakai untuk ruang di dalam restoran.

passage: On Saturday, Nadia and her cousin went to the mountain near their village. They waited at the bus stop for almost an hour. At noon, they ate rice and vegetables on a small hill. Nadia played with a dog in the field, and her cousin bought some fresh strawberries from an old farmer. In the afternoon, they came back home and told their parents a happy story.
prompt: Di mana Nadia dan sepupunya makan siang?
explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan mereka ate rice and vegetables on a small hill, jadi jawabannya di bukit kecil.

prompt: Ceritakan kegiatanmu kemarin dari pagi sampai malam. Gunakan preposisi waktu seperti at, in, dan on.
modelAnswer: Yesterday I woke up at six in the morning and went to the market with my mother. We bought vegetables and fruit, and then we ate lunch at a small restaurant. In the afternoon, I played badminton with my friends. I went home at seven in the evening and studied for an hour.
explanation: Esai ini melatih preposisi waktu at, in, dan on bersama kata kerja lampau dalam cerita harian.

script: Last Monday, Budi waited for his friend at the library for thirty minutes. Then they went to a cafe on Main Street and ate some noodles. Budi bought a notebook before he went home.
prompt: Di mana Budi menunggu temannya?
explanation: Dalam rekaman, Budi waited for his friend at the library, jadi jawabannya perpustakaan.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang artinya: Kami bermain di taman pada hari Sabtu.
acceptedAnswers: We played in the park on Saturday
explanation: Preposisi in dipakai untuk tempat seperti the park, dan on dipakai untuk nama hari seperti Saturday.

prompt: ___ you going to join the English club next semester?
explanation: Pertanyaan be going to diawali dengan to be yang sesuai subjek, yaitu are untuk you.

prompt: My father ___ fix the broken chair this weekend, because the wood is already in the garage.
explanation: Be going to dipakai untuk rencana yang sudah disiapkan, dan bahan kayu sudah ada di garasi.

prompt: Our teacher asked us to ___ for the exam by reading one chapter every night.
explanation: Prepare berarti mempersiapkan diri, dan membaca satu bab setiap malam adalah cara mempersiapkan ujian.

prompt: I ___ that it will not rain during our picnic tomorrow.
explanation: Hope berarti berharap untuk kejadian di masa depan, sedangkan remember dan forget berkaitan dengan ingatan.

prompt: Besok saya akan membantu ibu membersihkan dapur.
acceptedAnswers: Tomorrow I will help my mother clean the kitchen.
I will help my mother clean the kitchen tomorrow.
explanation: Will dipakai untuk tindakan di masa depan, dan kata tomorrow menunjukkan waktunya.

prompt: Kami berencana pergi berlibur ke Lombok bulan depan.
acceptedAnswers: We are going to go on holiday to Lombok next month.
We are going to travel to Lombok next month.
explanation: Be going to dipakai untuk rencana yang sudah dipikirkan sebelumnya, dan next month menunjukkan waktu mendatang.

passage: Rani has a plan for next weekend. On Saturday morning, she is going to join a cooking class with her friend Lia. Before class starts, she will buy vegetables at the market. On Sunday, she is going to paint her room, and her brother will help her carry the chairs. Rani thinks the weekend will be tiring, but she hopes it will be fun.
prompt: Apa rencana Rani pada hari Sabtu pagi?
explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan On Saturday morning, Rani is going to join a cooking class with her friend Lia, jadi jawabannya mengikuti kelas memasak.

prompt: Ceritakan rencanamu untuk minggu depan. Gunakan will untuk janji atau harapan dan be going to untuk rencana.
modelAnswer: Next week I am going to study for my English test on Monday. On Tuesday, I will visit my aunt because she is cooking a special dinner. I hope the weather will be nice so we can go to the park on Saturday. I promise I will finish all my homework before the weekend.
explanation: Esai ini melatih be going to untuk rencana dan will untuk janji serta harapan.

script: Tomorrow morning, Andi is going to visit the dentist because his tooth hurts. He will call his mother at noon to tell her about the appointment. After that, he plans to buy some soft food for lunch.
prompt: Ke mana Andi akan pergi besok pagi?
explanation: Dalam rekaman, Andi is going to visit the dentist besok pagi, jadi tujuannya ke dokter gigi.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang artinya: Kami akan bertemu di kafe setelah pulang sekolah.
acceptedAnswers: We will meet at the cafe after school
explanation: Will dipakai untuk rencana atau janji di masa depan, dan after school berarti setelah pulang sekolah.

prompt: She ___ speak three languages, so she often helps tourists at the hotel.
explanation: Modal can diikuti kata kerja bentuk dasar tanpa -s dan tanpa to.

prompt: Visitors ___ bring food into the museum, according to the sign at the entrance.
explanation: Must not dipakai untuk larangan yang berasal dari aturan, misalnya tanda di pintu masuk.

prompt: The teacher gave me some useful ___ on how to study English every day.
explanation: Advice adalah kata benda yang berarti saran, dan kata ini tidak memiliki bentuk jamak.

prompt: Parents are not ___ to enter the classroom during the test.
explanation: Allowed berarti diizinkan, sehingga orang tua tidak diizinkan masuk kelas saat ujian.

prompt: Kamu harus memakai seragam sekolah setiap hari Senin.
acceptedAnswers: You must wear your school uniform every Monday.
You must wear the school uniform every Monday.
explanation: Must dipakai untuk kewajiban, dan diikuti kata kerja bentuk dasar wear.

prompt: Kamu boleh masuk ke laboratorium setelah memakai jas lab.
acceptedAnswers: You can enter the laboratory after you wear a lab coat.
You may enter the laboratory after you put on a lab coat.
explanation: Can dan may dipakai untuk memberi izin, dan keduanya diikuti kata kerja bentuk dasar.

passage: At Sunrise Library, there are some important rules for visitors. Everyone must keep their voice low, and nobody can eat in the reading room. Students should return books on time because other readers may need them. The staff suggest that children bring a parent when they want to borrow more than three books. Mira read the rules and said she would follow all of them.
prompt: Apa yang dilarang di ruang baca menurut bacaan?
explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan nobody can eat in the reading room, jadi makan di ruang baca dilarang.

prompt: Ceritakan aturan yang harus kamu ikuti di rumah atau di sekolah. Gunakan must, should, atau can.
modelAnswer: At home I must wash the dishes after dinner. I should also keep my room clean every day. My parents allow me to watch TV, but I can only watch it after I finish my homework. I think these rules help me become more responsible.
explanation: Esai ini melatih modal must untuk kewajiban, should untuk saran, dan can untuk izin.

script: Dina is at the doctor's office. The doctor says she should drink more water and get enough sleep. She may take this medicine twice a day, but she must not take it with milk.
prompt: Apa yang harus dihindari Dina saat minum obatnya?
explanation: Dalam rekaman disebutkan she must not take it with milk, jadi minum obat dengan susu harus dihindari.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang artinya: Kamu tidak boleh membuang sampah di sungai.
acceptedAnswers: You must not throw garbage in the river
explanation: Must not dipakai untuk larangan, dan throw garbage in the river berarti membuang sampah di sungai.

prompt: Tono ___ his homework already, so he can play outside now.
explanation: Has finished dipakai untuk pekerjaan yang sudah selesai, dan already mendukung makna itu.

prompt: The team ___ the championship trophy, so they are very happy.
explanation: Present perfect has won dipakai untuk hasil yang sudah tercapai dan masih terasa sekarang.

prompt: Our class has ___ the whole chapter, so we can start the next lesson.
explanation: Completed berarti sudah menyelesaikan, dan cocok dengan bab yang sudah selesai dipelajari.

prompt: I can't find my phone. Have you ___ it somewhere in the kitchen?
explanation: Have you seen it berarti apakah kamu pernah melihatnya, dan dipakai untuk menanyakan keberadaan benda.

prompt: Saya sudah mencoba makanan khas Padang, dan rasanya enak sekali.
acceptedAnswers: I have tried Padang food, and it tastes delicious.
I have tried Padang food and it tastes very good.
explanation: Present perfect memakai have atau has diikuti kata kerja bentuk ketiga, seperti tried.

prompt: Adik saya sudah kehilangan kunci rumahnya dua kali bulan ini.
acceptedAnswers: My little brother has lost his house key twice this month.
My younger brother has lost his house keys two times this month.
explanation: Has lost adalah present perfect dari lose, dengan subjek tunggal yang memakai has dan bentuk ketiga lost.

passage: Rani is a young photographer from Makassar. She has visited six cities in Indonesia, and she has learned a lot about local cultures. Last year she completed a photo project about traditional markets. During a trip to Bromo, she lost her camera, but a kind driver found it the next day. Rani has never seen such a beautiful sunrise before, and she has tried to take a photo of it every morning since then.
prompt: Apa yang terjadi dengan kamera Rani?
explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan kamera Rani hilang saat perjalanan ke Bromo, lalu ditemukan oleh sopir keesokan harinya.

prompt: Ceritakan pengalaman yang pernah kamu lakukan, misalnya tempat yang pernah kamu kunjungi atau makanan yang pernah kamu coba. Gunakan present perfect.
modelAnswer: I have visited three islands in my country. I have tried many traditional foods, such as satay and gudeg. I have also learned how to swim, and I have met many friendly people on my trips. These experiences have made me more curious about the world.
explanation: Esai ini melatih present perfect (have/has + bentuk ketiga) untuk pengalaman yang pernah terjadi.

script: Hi, this is Lina. I have finished my science project, and I have also cleaned my desk. My friend has lost his pencil case again, so he is looking for it now.
prompt: Apa yang sudah selesai dikerjakan Lina?
explanation: Dalam rekaman Lina says I have finished my science project, jadi itulah yang sudah selesai.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang artinya: Mereka sudah menemukan dompet yang hilang.
acceptedAnswers: They have found the lost wallet
explanation: Have found adalah present perfect dari find, dan lost wallet berarti dompet yang hilang.

prompt: We ___ to Bandung last summer, and we loved the food there.
explanation: Keterangan waktu tertentu seperti last summer memakai simple past, bukan present perfect.

prompt: She ___ her homework yet, so she cannot go out with us.
explanation: Yet dipakai dengan present perfect negatif, yaitu has not finished yet.

prompt: My cousin has ___ moved to Medan, and she is still looking for a new school.
explanation: Recently berarti baru-baru ini, dan cocok dengan present perfect untuk kejadian yang baru terjadi.

prompt: The bakery has been closed ___ Monday, so we need to buy bread somewhere else.
explanation: Since dipakai untuk titik awal waktu seperti since Monday, sedangkan for dipakai untuk durasi.

prompt: Saya belum pernah naik pesawat terbang.
acceptedAnswers: I have never flown on a plane.
I have never been on a plane.
explanation: Never dan before dipakai dengan present perfect untuk pengalaman yang belum pernah terjadi.

prompt: Dia baru saja sampai di terminal bus dan sekarang sedang menelepon ayahnya.
acceptedAnswers: He has just arrived at the bus terminal and is calling his father now.
He has just arrived at the bus terminal, and now he is calling his father.
explanation: Just dipakai dengan present perfect untuk kejadian yang baru saja terjadi, sedangkan is calling dipakai untuk kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung.

passage: Yuki arrived in Jakarta two years ago to study architecture. She has lived in a small room near the campus since then. Last month, she moved to a bigger apartment with her best friend, Sari. Yuki has never regretted her decision, but she still misses her hometown in Kyoto. Last week, she visited Kyoto for a few days and cooked her grandmother's favorite soup. She came back to Jakarta feeling happy and ready to finish her thesis.
prompt: Kapan Yuki pindah ke apartemen yang lebih besar?
explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan Last month, she moved to a bigger apartment, jadi jawabannya bulan lalu.

prompt: Ceritakan satu kejadian tahun lalu dan satu pengalaman yang pernah kamu alami sampai sekarang. Gunakan simple past untuk kejadian tahun lalu dan present perfect untuk pengalaman.
modelAnswer: Last year I visited my grandmother in Malang for two weeks. I have not visited the city since then, but I hope to go back soon. This week I have already finished my English homework and cleaned my room. I have never missed a deadline, and I want to keep it that way.
explanation: Esai ini membedakan simple past untuk waktu lampau yang spesifik dan present perfect untuk pengalaman atau hal yang berhubungan dengan sekarang.

script: Hello, my name is Tomi. I have worked at this bakery for three years. Last Monday, I started a new job at the library, and I still work there every afternoon.
prompt: Kapan Tomi mulai bekerja di perpustakaan?
explanation: Dalam rekaman, Tomi started a new job at the library last Monday, sedangkan tiga tahun berkaitan dengan toko roti.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang artinya: Saya sudah pernah mengunjungi museum itu.
acceptedAnswers: I have visited that museum before
explanation: Have visited dipakai untuk pengalaman yang pernah terjadi, dan before menandakan kejadian itu sudah terjadi sebelumnya.

prompt: We have ___ milk in the fridge, so we need to buy more today.
explanation: Milk adalah kata benda tak terhitung, sehingga dipakai a little untuk jumlah yang sedikit.

prompt: The furniture in the new house ___ very expensive.
explanation: Furniture adalah kata benda tak terhitung yang memakai kata kerja tunggal, yaitu is.

prompt: The workers need new ___ to build the bridge faster, such as cranes and drills.
explanation: Equipment berarti peralatan, dan crane serta drill termasuk contoh peralatan.

prompt: The road was blocked by heavy ___, so we arrived at the office two hours late.
explanation: Traffic berarti lalu lintas yang padat, dan kemacetan membuat kita terlambat tiba di kantor.

prompt: Ibu saya membeli dua kilogram beras dan sedikit gula di pasar.
acceptedAnswers: My mother bought two kilograms of rice and a little sugar at the market.
My mother bought two kilos of rice and some sugar at the market.
explanation: Rice dan sugar adalah kata benda tak terhitung, sehingga memakai a little atau some, bukan many.

prompt: Kami punya banyak air minum, jadi kami tidak perlu membeli lagi.
acceptedAnswers: We have plenty of drinking water, so we do not need to buy more.
We have a lot of drinking water, so we don't need to buy more.
explanation: Water adalah kata benda tak terhitung, jadi kita memakai plenty of atau a lot of, bukan many.

passage: Rina runs a small coffee shop near the station. She has many customers in the morning, and she needs a lot of milk and sugar every day. Yesterday there was not enough bread, so she bought a few loaves from a nearby bakery. Her biggest problem is the money for new equipment, because the coffee machine is old. Rina hopes that next month she will have enough money to buy a better one.
prompt: Apa masalah terbesar Rina?
explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan masalah terbesarnya adalah uang untuk peralatan baru, karena mesin kopinya sudah tua.

prompt: Ceritakan isi kulkas atau lemari dapurmu. Gunakan some, any, a lot of, many, much, a little, atau few.
modelAnswer: In my kitchen there is some rice and a lot of cooking oil. We do not have any milk today, so I need to buy some. My mother has many eggs, but she has only a little sugar. We should buy more fruit because we have very few apples left.
explanation: Esai ini melatih kata benda terhitung dan tak terhitung dengan quantifier yang tepat.

script: Hello, I'm at the supermarket. There is a lot of bread here, but the milk is almost finished. Please buy a few eggs and a little coffee when you come home.
prompt: Apa yang diminta pembicara untuk dibeli?

options.text: a few eggs and a little coffee

explanation: Dalam rekaman, pembicara meminta dibelikan a few eggs and a little coffee, sedangkan roti sudah banyak tersedia.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris yang artinya: Kami membutuhkan lebih banyak air dan roti.
acceptedAnswers: We need more water and bread
explanation: More dipakai dengan kata benda tak terhitung seperti water, dan bread juga termasuk tak terhitung.

prompt: ___ time does the bakery open on Sunday?
explanation: What time berarti jam berapa, dan what dipakai sebelum kata benda time untuk menanyakan waktu.

prompt: ___ did the children eat for breakfast this morning?
explanation: What dipakai untuk menanyakan benda atau makanan yang dimakan, sedangkan who untuk orang.

prompt: I need to know ___ the meeting will begin, because I don't want to be late.
explanation: When dipakai untuk menanyakan waktu, sehingga cocok dengan kapan rapat akan dimulai.

prompt: ___ students in our class have visited Japan?
explanation: How many dipakai untuk menanyakan jumlah benda yang bisa dihitung, seperti students.

prompt: Kapan kamu akan pergi ke bandara besok?
acceptedAnswers: When will you go to the airport tomorrow?
When are you going to the airport tomorrow?
explanation: Pertanyaan waktu memakai when, dan rencana besok bisa memakai will atau be going to.

prompt: Siapa yang membawa kunci mobil ke kantor tadi pagi?
acceptedAnswers: Who brought the car keys to the office this morning?
Who took the car keys to the office this morning?
explanation: Who dipakai sebagai subjek untuk menanyakan orang, dan tadi pagi memakai bentuk lampau brought atau took.

passage: Dimas is a new student at a language school in Yogyakarta. On his first day, he could not find his classroom. He asked a security guard, 'Where is the English room?' The guard smiled and pointed to the second floor. Then Dimas asked a classmate, 'What time does the class start?' The classmate answered, 'At eight o'clock. You still have ten minutes.' Dimas thanked them both and ran upstairs happily.
prompt: Mengapa Dimas bertanya kepada satpam?
explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan Dimas bertanya Where is the English room, yaitu menanyakan lokasi ruang kelas.

prompt: Buat tiga pertanyaan yang ingin kamu tanyakan kepada guru bahasa Inggrismu, lalu jelaskan alasannya. Gunakan kata tanya what, why, dan how.
modelAnswer: What is the best way to remember new vocabulary? Why do some English words have irregular spelling? How can I improve my speaking without feeling nervous? I want to ask these questions because I want to learn English faster and speak with more confidence.
explanation: Esai ini melatih pembuatan pertanyaan terbuka dengan kata tanya what, why, dan how.

script: Excuse me, what time does the post office close today? I need to send a package to my aunt in Medan. It closes at four in the afternoon, so I still have time.
prompt: Jam berapa kantor pos tutup hari ini?
explanation: Dalam rekaman disebutkan It closes at four in the afternoon, jadi jawabannya pukul empat sore.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat tanya bahasa Inggris yang artinya: Di mana kamu membeli tas barumu?
acceptedAnswers: Where did you buy your new bag
explanation: Pertanyaan dengan where memakai did, lalu subjek diikuti kata kerja bentuk dasar buy.
